brief: Delhi -> Agra -> Jaipur, 6 days (land Sun 8 Nov, Diwali morning; fly out Sat 14 Nov, 18:40). Two travelers. Budget 60,000 INR for food + tickets + local transport + the two train legs; hotels separate, gifts separate (this crew does not count gifts). Cousin's wedding in Jaipur on Fri 13 Nov, sangeet Thu 12 Nov evening. Style: one big free-icon per day, street food counts as a stop, nobody stands in a queue for more than 20 minutes.

days.note: DIWALI day — India Gate lights + Akshardham evening show
Monday: Humayun's Tomb closed, Qutub closed Wed - placement handled
Taj in the morning (closed Mondays, so Tuesday it is)
Agra -> Jaipur 10:40 train (5h 15m), forts by late afternoon
sangeet 19:00 - gifts must be done by 16:00

detour.via: Delhi -> Agra 1h 30m + Agra -> Jaipur 5h 15m — Agra is 45 min off the NH48 you would drive anyway
detour.reason: the Taj Mahal is on the way. It costs 3 hours, not a day.
